meta.name: Tidewatch
meta.tagline: The next tide, at a glance.
meta.summary: A fictional Android app for watching live and cached tide charts along the coast.

story.headline: Tide charts that stay useful away from the signal.
story.problem: Coastal walks often start beyond reliable mobile coverage, where a chart that only works online is no help.
story.approach: Keep a recent tide window on the phone, refresh it when a live feed is available, and present both paths in one clear chart.
story.outcome: A small Android app that switches between fresh readings and a saved forecast without interrupting the view.

layers.name: Interface
layers.description: The screens and the person using them.

components.name: Beachgoer
components.summary: A person checking the next high tide.
components.description: Chooses a nearby beach, opens its chart, and reads the tide curve.

components.name: Tide Chart Screen
components.summary: The main chart and its live-or-saved state.
components.description: Draws the tide curve, highlights the next high and low water, and shows whether the reading is live.

components.name: Forecast Details Panel
components.summary: A compact view of the selected day's tide events.
components.description: Lists high and low water times beneath the chart when the reader expands the selected day.

layers.name: View state
layers.description: The chart state the interface observes.

components.name: Tide View Model
components.summary: Combines the selected beach with the latest tide series.
components.description: Exposes one chart state and refreshes it when a live reading or saved forecast arrives.

layers.name: Tide data
layers.description: The paths that fetch and retain tide readings.

components.name: Tide Repository
components.summary: Chooses between a live reading and the saved forecast.
components.description: Keeps the live reading and the phone's stored forecast in step so the chart always has something useful to show.

components.name: Live Tide Client
components.summary: Keeps the current tide reading in step.
components.description: Receives tide updates and hands each new series to the repository.

components.name: Tide Cache
components.summary: The saved forecast kept on the phone.
components.description: Retains recent tide series for beaches the reader has opened.

layers.name: External boundary
layers.description: The public source of tide observations.

components.name: Tide Feed
components.summary: A public feed of coastal tide readings.
components.description: Publishes fictional water-level observations for the beaches shown in the app.

flows.label: Live update
flows.description: A new tide reading travels from the public feed to the chart.

flows.label: Saved forecast
flows.description: A reader opens the saved tide curve when the live feed is unavailable.
